load_annotations_Kitti2DDataset: load KITTI 2D dataset annotations from a JSON file into the Kitti2DDataset instance
get_ann_info_Kitti2DDataset: get ground truth bounding boxes and labels for a given image index in the KITTI 2D dataset
filter_imgs_Kitti2DDataset: filter out images that have no ground truth annotations in the KITTI 2D dataset
reformat_bbox_Kitti2DDataset: reformat model inference outputs into KITTI 2D bounding box result format for evaluation
evaluate_Kitti2DDataset: evaluate KITTI 2D detection results using the official KITTI bbox average precision protocol
